title: Moon Horror Den
wikitext:
[[Image:Moon Horror Den.jpg|thumb|Moon Horror Den]]
'''Moon Horror Den''' is a small cave inhabited by [[Raging Owlbeast|Raging Owlbeasts]]. However, they may not always be there, as many players complete {{questlong|Horde|56|Wild Guardians (1)}}. It is situated quite close to [[Everlook]], just a short walk to the northeast from the city gates. Despite its apparent closeness to the [[Winterfall Village]] however, the mountain itself blocks a direct path and a long ride around is needed to head further south from the cave.
